text_1981: Mt. Sinai.
text_1989: Mt. Sinai.

text_1981: And the scripture that is recorded.
text_1989: The recorded scripture.
text_ref: The recorded scripture.

text_1981: And published on paper.
text_1989: Published in books.
text_ref: Published in books.

text_1981: By the frequented shrine.
text_1989: The frequented Shrine.
text_ref: The frequented Shrine.

text_1981: With its high ceiling. . 6 By the vast ocean.
text_1989: The exalted ceiling.
text_ref: The exalted ceiling.

text_1981: The sea that is set aflame.
text_1989: The sea that is set aflame.

text_1981: The retribution from your Lord is a reality.
text_1989: Your Lord’s requital is unavoidable.
text_ref: Your Lord's requital is unavoidable.

text_1981: Nothing can stop it.
text_1989: No force in the universe can stop it.
text_ref: No force in the universe can stop it.

text_1981: That is the day when the heaven will violently thunder. . 10 The mountains will be erased.
text_1989: The day will come when the sky will violently thunder.
text_ref: The day will come when the sky will violently thunder.

text_1981: The mountains will be wiped out.
text_1989: The mountains will be wiped out.
text_ref: The mountains will be wiped out.

text_1981: Woe on that day to the rejectors.
text_1989: Woe on that day to the disbelievers—
text_ref: Woe on that day to the disbelievers—

text_1981: Who are heedless and playing.
text_1989: who are in their blundering, heedless.
text_ref: who are in their blundering, heedless.

text_1981: On that day, they will be herded to the fire of hell.
text_1989: They will be herded into Gehenna, forcibly.
text_ref: They will be herded into Gehenna, forcibly.

text_1981: This is the fire that you used to deny.
text_1989: This is the Fire in which you used to disbelieve. 1 2408 Mt.
text_ref: This is the Fire in which you used to disbelieve.

text_1981: Is this magic, or do you not see? 16.
text_1989: Is this magic, or do you not see? 524
text_ref: Is this magic, or do you not see?

text_1981: Suffer the burning. Whether you are patient or impatient, it will be the same for you. This is the just requital for what you did.
text_1989: Suffer the burning. Whether you are patient or impatient, it will be the same for you. This is the just requital for what you did.
text_ref: Suffer the burning. Whether you are patient or impatient, it will be the same for you. This is the just requital for what you did.

text_1981: As for the righteous, they have deserved gardens of bliss. 18.
text_1989: The righteous have deserved gardens and bliss.
text_ref: The righteous have deserved gardens and bliss.

text_1981: They enjoy what their Lord has reserved for them; their Lord has spared them the retribution of Hell.
text_1989: They enjoy what their Lord has reserved for them; their Lord has spared them the retribution of Hell.
text_ref: They enjoy what their Lord has reserved for them; their Lord has spared them the retribution of Hell.

text_1981: Eat and drink with blessings, in return for what you did. . 20 They relax on rows of furnishings, and we join with them magnificent spouses.*
text_1989: Eat and drink happily, in return for your works.
text_ref: Eat and drink happily, in return for your works.

text_1981: They relax on luxurious furnishings, and we match them with beautiful spouses.
text_1989: They relax on luxurious furnishings, and we match them with beautiful spouses.
text_ref: They relax on luxurious furnishings, and we match them with beautiful spouses.

text_1981: For those who believed, and their children also followed them in belief, we will have their children join them. We never fail to reward them for any work. Every person is paid for what he did.
text_1989: For those who believed, and their children also followed them in belief, we will have their children join them. them for any work. is paid for what he did.
text_ref: For those who believed, and their children also followed them in belief, we will have their children join them. We never fail to reward them for any work. Every person is paid for what he did.

text_1981: We will supply them with fruits and meats that they love.
text_1989: We will supply them with fruits and meats that they love.
text_ref: We will supply them with fruits and meats that they love.

text_1981: They will share drinks that never run out and are never polluted.
text_1989: They will enjoy drinks that are never polluted, and never sinful to drink.
text_ref: They will enjoy drinks that are never polluted, and never sinful to drink.

text_1981: Serving them will be servants like precious pearls.
text_1989: Serving them will be servants like protected pearls.
text_ref: Serving them will be servants like protected pearls.

text_1981: They will converse with each other.
text_1989: They will meet each other and reminisce among themselves.
text_ref: They will meet each other and reminisce among themselves.

text_1981: They will say, “We used to be humble among our people.
text_1989: They will say, “We used to be kind and humble among our people.
text_ref: They will say, "We used to be kind and humble among our people.

text_1981: “Then God showered us with His blessings and spared us the agony of ill winds.
text_1989: “GOD has blessed us, and has spared us the agony of ill winds.
text_ref: "GOD has blessed us, and has spared us the agony of ill winds.

text_1981: “We used to implore Him; He is the benign, the merciful.”
text_1989: “We used to implore Him; He is the Most Kind, Most Merciful.”
text_ref: "We used to implore Him; He is the Most Kind, Most Merciful."

subtitle: The Messenger
text_1981: You shall remind the people. With your Lord's blessings upon you, you are neither a soothsayer, nor crazy.
text_1989: You shall remind the people. With your Lord’s blessing’s upon you, you are neither a soothsayer, nor crazy.
text_ref: You shall remind the people. With your Lord's blessings upon you, you are neither a soothsayer, nor crazy.

text_1981: They may say, "He is a poet; let us just wait until he is dead."
text_1989: They may say, “He is a poet; let us just wait until he is dead.”
text_ref: They may say, "He is a poet; let us just wait until he is dead."

text_1981: Say, "Go on waiting; I will wait along with you."
text_1989: Say, “Go on waiting; I will wait along with you.” 1 2409 Mt. r 525
text_ref: Say, "Go on waiting; I will wait along with you."

text_1981: Is it their dreams that lead them to this, or is it wickedness?
text_1989: Is it their dreams that dictate their behavior, or are they naturally wicked?
text_ref: Is it their dreams that dictate their behavior, or are they naturally wicked?

text_1981: Do they say that he made this up? They simply cannot believe.
text_1989: Do they say, “He made it all up?” Instead, they are simply disbelievers.
text_ref: Do they say, "He made it all up?" Instead, they are simply disbelievers.

subtitle: "Mohammedans" Challenge God and Produce Hadith
text_1981: Let them show us a “hadith” (narration) like this, if they are truthful.
text_1989: Let them produce a Hadith like this, if they are truthful.
text_ref: Let them produce a Hadith like this, if they are truthful.

text_1981: Were they created out of nothing? Could they be the creators?
text_1989: Were they created from nothing? Are they the creators? “Mohammedans” Challenge God and Produce Hadith
text_ref: Were they created from nothing? Are they the creators?

text_1981: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Indeed, they are never certain.
text_1989: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Indeed, they have no certainty.
text_ref: Did they create the heavens and the earth? Indeed, they have no certainty.

text_1981: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord? Are they in control? 38.
text_1989: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord? Are they in control?
text_ref: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord? Are they in control?

text_1981: Do they climb a ladder that enables them to listen? Let their listeners show their proof.
text_1989: Do they climb a ladder that enables them to listen? show their proof.
text_ref: Do they climb a ladder that enables them to listen? Let their listeners show their proof.

text_1981: Does God have daughters, while you have sons?
text_1989: Does He have daughters, while you have sons?
text_ref: Does He have daughters, while you have sons?

text_1981: Are you asking them for a wage, so they are burdened thereby?
text_1989: Are you asking them for any wage, and they are burdened thereby?
text_ref: Are you asking them for any wage, and they are burdened thereby?

text_1981: Do they know the future and record it?
text_1989: Do they know the future, and have it recorded?
text_ref: Do they know the future, and have it recorded?

text_1981: Is it obstruction that they seek? The disbelievers only hinder themselves. 43.
text_1989: Are they plotting and scheming? against them.
text_ref: Are they plotting and scheming? The disbelievers' schemes backfire against them.

text_1981: Do they have another god besides GOD? GOD be glorified, far above having partners.
text_1989: Do they have another god besides GOD? having partners.
text_ref: Do they have another god besides GOD? GOD be glorified, far above having partners.

text_1981: When they see masses falling from the sky, they will say, "Piled clouds!"
text_1989: When they see masses falling from the sky, they will say, “Piled clouds!”
text_ref: When they see masses falling from the sky, they will say, "Piled clouds!"

text_1981: Therefore, disregard them until they meet their day of doom. 46.
text_1989: Disregard them until they meet the day in which they are struck.
text_ref: Disregard them until they meet the day in which they are struck.

text_1981: On that day, their schemes will not protect them, nor will they be helped.
text_1989: On that day, their schemes will not protect them, nor will they be helped
text_ref: On that day, their schemes will not protect them, nor will they be helped.

text_1981: The wicked actually suffer retribution in this life, without realizing it.
text_1989: Those who transgress suffer retribution here, but most of them do not know.
text_ref: Those who transgress suffer retribution here, but most of them do not know.

text_1981: You shall steadfastly persevere in preaching the message of your Lord. You are in our eyes. And praise the glory of your Lord when you get up.
text_1989: You shall steadfastly persevere in carrying out your Lord’s command—you are in our eyes—and glorify and praise your Lord when you get up.
text_ref: You shall steadfastly persevere in carrying out your Lord's command—you are in our eyes—and glorify and praise your Lord when you get up.

text_1981: Glorify Him during the night, and at dawn, as the stars fade away.
text_1989: Also during the night glorify Him, and at dawn as the stars fade away.
text_ref: Also during the night glorify Him, and at dawn as the stars fade away.
